title: Girl Shrieks With Joy Over Doll With One Leg
main_content:
Ten-year-old Emma Bennett got a surprise gift that made her very happy.

She was given an American Girl doll that looks very much like her. The doll also had a prosthetic leg, just like hers!

Emma’s mother and father bought the toy from an American Girl store. They then asked a company called A Step Ahead Prosthetics to make changes to the doll. The company replaced the leg with what looks like a man-made leg, like Emma’s.

On social media, a video shows when the doll was given to Emma.

When Emma opens her gift and sees the American Girl doll, she begins to cry. Emma is amazed that the doll has a leg like hers.

People on social media were touched by the video.

Some felt that the pictures showed how important it was for people to feel like they are represented in society.

At the end of the video, Emma thanks A Step Ahead Prosthetics by saying, “Thank you for making a doll like me.”

questions.question: Why did Emma get a doll with one leg?
options: A. To show diversity among dolls
B. Because she had asked for it specifically
C. To represent her own condition in a meaningful way
D. Because the company made a mistake
questions.answer: C. To represent her own condition in a meaningful way

questions.question: What company made changes to the doll?
How did people on social media react to the video?
options: A. They were uninterested and did not comment
B. They criticized the idea of a doll with a prosthetic leg
C. They were touched and showed support for representation
D. They shared their own experiences with dolls
questions.answer: C. They were touched and showed support for representation
